name: Warrior 3 Pose
description: Balance on one leg with the torso and lifted leg level with the floor.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand in Mountain Pose and shift your weight onto one foot.
Put your hands on your hips or reach your arms forward before you tip.

keyframes.name: Mountain Pose
keyframes.cue: Stand tall with your feet together and arms by your sides.

keyframes.name: Warrior 3
keyframes.cue: Tip forward on the left leg and lift the right leg back.

cues: Reach long through the heel and the fingertips.
